dialects.changedOutside: This file changed outside Combwork while you were editing it.
dialects.claimMoved: {name} has model {model} now: {from} became a test copy.
dialects.claimTaken: Another file of this folder, {by}, claims model {model} first: Auto never picks this one.
dialects.claimedBy: {name} already has this model: it becomes a test copy.
dialects.counts: {overrides, plural, one {# text changed here} other {# texts changed here}} of {total, number}
dialects.deleteMessage: It goes to the Recycle Bin. Agents whose Dialect setting names it use Auto from their next launch.
dialects.duplicateMessage: The copy has the same texts. With a model, agents on Auto running it get the copy from their next launch. Without one it's a test copy, which an agent uses only when its Dialect setting picks it (Agent Settings).
dialects.fileProblem.shape: "{field}" is missing or of the wrong kind
dialects.gone: This dialect file is no longer there.
dialects.importMessage: It is checked against this Combwork's texts. If its model is already claimed in the folder, it comes in as a test copy.
dialects.importedCopy: {path} imported as a test copy: its model is already claimed in that folder.
dialects.jsonLeaveMessage: The Texts tab can only show the file as it last read: {why}. Drop what you typed since then?
dialects.jsonLeaveTitle: The JSON isn't a dialect file
dialects.kind.copy: Test copy: agents that pick it
dialects.modelControl: A model ID has no control characters or line breaks.
dialects.nameCli: "cli" is the name of the CLI's own file: choose another.
dialects.nameEnd: A name can't end with a dot or a space.
dialects.nameInFolder: {name} is already in this folder: choose another name.
dialects.nameProblem: A name with no / \ : * ? " < > |, not starting with a dot.
dialects.nameReserved: {name} is a name Windows keeps for itself, as it does CON, NUL and COM1.
dialects.newMessage: An empty file: it inherits every text until you change one in it. With a model, agents on Auto running it get this file from their next launch. Without one it's a test copy, which an agent uses only when its Dialect setting picks it.
dialects.noDefault: No current Default: this text was removed or renamed in this Combwork.
dialects.noWorkspace: Open a workspace to see its dialects.
dialects.notSeen: No agent has run this model yet.
dialects.onTip: On: its texts apply. Off: {to, select, cli {it falls back to the {name} file} workspace {it falls back to the Workspace file} other {it falls back to Combwork's Default}}. Changes apply at each agent's next launch.
dialects.problem.unknown: {id}: no such text in this Combwork (removed or renamed).
dialects.promoteMessage: Agents on Auto running this model ID get this file from their next launch. A file that had the model keeps its texts, as a test copy.
dialects.refused.changedOnDisk: The file changed outside Combwork since you started editing it: nothing was saved.
dialects.refused.modelClaimed: {by} already claims model {model}: a folder has one file per model.
dialects.refused.modelHere: Only a model file or test copy in a CLI folder can have a model: not the Workspace, CLI or API file.
dialects.refused.nameTaken: {path} is already there: choose another name.
dialects.refused.notYours: Only your own model files and test copies take Set Model: not a shipped file, nor the CLI, API or Workspace files.
dialects.refused.path: That isn't a dialect file's place.
dialects.refused.protected: The Workspace file, a CLI's file and a shipped file can't be deleted.
dialects.refused.title: Not saved
dialects.restart: {count, plural, one {Restart to apply: {agents} runs on this file as it was.} other {Restart to apply: {agents} run on this file as it was.}}
dialects.revertMessage: Your changes to it are lost, and it follows Combwork's updates again.
dialects.saved: {name} saved: it applies at each agent's next launch.
dialects.savedAs: Saved as {model}, the ID agents run it as.
dialects.select: Choose a dialect file to see every text it gives agents.
dialects.tip: The wording Combwork gives agents: its guidance, its tools' descriptions and replies, its wakes. A dialect file changes some of it, for a model, a CLI or the whole workspace; everything else stays Combwork's own. A change applies at each agent's next launch.
dialects.title: Dialects
dialects.unresolvedAlias: {model} is an alias Combwork can't resolve now: agents running it show as model unknown, so this file wouldn't match. Type the model's ID.
dialects.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # running agent: {agents}} other {Used by # running agents: {agents}}}
dialects.whyPlaceholder: What it fixes, and how it was measured
